blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte should answer allegations of corruption with evidence instead of pointing fingers at the administration, Malacañang said on Sunday. Palace press officer Undersecretary Claire Castro said claims raised by whistleblower, dismissed policeman Rodulfo Gracioso Jr., should be investigated, but the government should first establish the truth before making any judgment. “If such information is coming to light, we cannot turn a blind eye to it. We cannot simply ignore it. It needs to be investigated, and if anything is proven, then it should [be acted upon],” Castro told state-run PTV. In an interview with GMA News, […]...
